item.title: Building AI-assisted workflows for quantum research
item.description:
This blog will collect short notes on AI-assisted quantum research, quantum architecture, quantum computing, and engineering workflows.

My goal is modest: to use this space for organizing ideas, implementation notes, and reproducible workflows that connect research questions with working software systems. Topics may include quantum information processing, quantum architecture experiments, quantum software tooling, and practical lessons from building AI-assisted research systems.

I will keep the notes concise and grounded in what I am actually learning or building.

item.title: AutoQEC
item.description: AutoQEC is an AI-assisted research and engineering system for quantum error correction. It explores automated workflows for discovering neural predecoders and hybrid decoding pipelines for quantum error-correcting codes.

item.title: Nonlinear functions of quantum states
item.description: This work studies nonlinear functions of quantum states. It previously appeared as arXiv:2412.01696 and is now a Communications Physics article.
